notes:
Released 2026-08-16. Diagnostic bundles no longer carry the subscription token, and
switching service mode from a degraded core is no longer a silent no-op.

## Privacy

- The panel mints subscription links in a **path** form —
  `https://<host>/<subscribe_path>/<32 hex token>` — while all fifteen
  redaction rules were written for the retired `?token=` query form. None of
  them matched, so a failed subscription fetch wrote the full URL into the
  event log through `HttpException`, and from there into the support bundle.
  A new rule matches on the shape of a long credential rather than on any URL
  layout, so a future panel-side path change cannot silently un-redact it.
- The regression fixture now uses the shape production actually mints; the old
  fixture used the retired one, which is why the guard stayed green over the
  hole.

## Reliability

- Switching the service mode while the core is `degraded` (tunnel up, egress
  impaired) took the `start()` path, where the core manager returns success
  immediately because it is already running. The switch reported success, gave
  no warning, and left the kernel in the previous mode. A degraded core is a
  live core, and is now restarted like a running one.
